```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

ROOT = Path.cwd()
while not (ROOT / "_quarto.yml").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import chart_style as cs

d = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data/processed/core_daily.csv", parse_dates=["date"]).set_index("date")
m = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data/processed/core_monthly.csv", parse_dates=["month"]).set_index("month")
S = cs.SURF[cs.MODE]
fmt = lambda v, dec=0: "–" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:,.{dec}f}"

# Chart groups: the stack order in palette.json (bottom to top), plus unmetered solar on top.
GROUPS = {"coal": ["lignite_mwh", "imported_coal_mwh", "hard_coal_mwh"], "geothermal": ["geothermal_mwh"],
          "biomass": ["biomass_mwh"], "hydro": ["hydro_dam_mwh", "hydro_river_mwh"], "gas": ["gas_mwh"],
          "wind": ["wind_mwh"], "solar": ["solar_mwh"], "other": ["other_mwh"]}
RENEWABLE = ["geothermal", "biomass", "hydro", "wind", "solar"]
BREAK = pd.Timestamp("2020-12-30")   # real-time consumption starts to include unmetered generation

def grouped(df):
    out = pd.DataFrame({k: df[cols].sum(axis=1, min_count=len(cols)) for k, cols in GROUPS.items()})
    out["solar_unmetered"] = df["embedded_gen_est_mwh"].clip(lower=0)
    return out

gm = grouped(m).loc["2014-01-01":]
complete = m["hours_with_price"] >= 24 * 27          # leave the current partial month out of the charts
gm_full = gm[complete.loc[gm.index]]
dd = d[d["total_mwh"].notna()]
last = dd.index.max()
```

```{python}
#| label: stamp
HTML(cs.data_stamp("core_daily.csv"))
```

```{python}
#| label: tiles
def renew_share(df):
    g = grouped(df)
    metered = g[list(GROUPS)].sum().sum()
    return g[RENEWABLE].sum().sum() / metered, (g[RENEWABLE].sum().sum() + g["solar_unmetered"].sum()) / (metered + g["solar_unmetered"].sum())

yr = dd.loc[last - pd.DateOffset(years=1) + pd.Timedelta(days=1): last]
prev = dd.loc[last - pd.DateOffset(years=2) + pd.Timedelta(days=1): last - pd.DateOffset(years=1)]
share, share_all = renew_share(yr)
share_prev, _ = renew_share(prev)
cons, cons_prev = yr["consumption_mwh"].sum() / 1e6, prev["consumption_mwh"].sum() / 1e6
peak_day = d.loc[f"{last.year}-01-01":, "peak_consumption_mw"].idxmax()
unm12 = yr["embedded_gen_est_mwh"].clip(lower=0).sum() / 1e6

tiles = [
    ("Renewable share, last 12 months", f"{share:.0%} of metered generation",
     f"{share_all:.0%} including unmetered solar · {share_prev:.0%} a year earlier (metered)"),
    ("Consumption, last 12 months", f"{cons:,.0f} TWh",
     f"{(cons / cons_prev - 1) * 100:+.1f}% on the previous 12 months".replace("-", "−")),
    (f"Peak demand in {last.year}", f"{d.loc[peak_day, 'peak_consumption_mw']:,.0f} MW",
     f"hourly peak on {peak_day:%d %B}"),
    ("Unmetered generation, last 12 months", f"{unm12:.1f} TWh",
     f"{unm12 / (cons / 1) * 100:.0f}% of reported consumption (estimate)"),
]
HTML('<div class="tile-grid">' + "".join(
    f'<div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">{a}</p><h3>{b}</h3><p>{c}</p></div>' for a, b, c in tiles) + "</div>")
```

## Generation by source

Monthly generation from the real-time generation data, grouped by source. The hatched band at the top is our estimate of solar output that the real-time data does not meter: mostly small, unlicensed plants on distribution grids (see [notes](#notes)). Switch to **Share** to see each source as a percentage of the total.

```{python}
#| label: mix-chart
fig = cs.figure(None, "TWh per month", height=480)
keys = list(GROUPS) + ["solar_unmetered"]
for k in keys:
    cs.add_area(fig, gm_full.index, gm_full[k] / 1e6, "generation", k, hatch=(k == "solar_unmetered"),
                unit=" TWh", hover_fmt=",.2f")
twh_hover = [t.hovertemplate for t in fig.data]
pct_hover = [f"%{{y:.1f}}%<extra>{t.name}</extra>" for t in fig.data]
fig.update_layout(
    margin=dict(t=48),
    updatemenus=[dict(type="buttons", direction="right", active=0, x=0, y=1.03, xanchor="left", yanchor="bottom",
                      buttons=[dict(label="TWh", method="update",
                                    args=[{"groupnorm": [""] * len(keys), "hovertemplate": twh_hover},
                                          {"yaxis.title.text": "TWh per month", "yaxis.ticksuffix": ""}]),
                               dict(label="Share", method="update",
                                    args=[{"groupnorm": ["percent"] * len(keys), "hovertemplate": pct_hover},
                                          {"yaxis.title.text": "Share of generation", "yaxis.ticksuffix": "%"}])])],
)
fig.update_xaxes(rangeselector=dict(buttons=[dict(count=3, label="3Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                                             dict(count=5, label="5Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                                             dict(step="all", label="All")],
                                    x=1, xanchor="right", y=1.03, yanchor="bottom"))
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(traceorder="reversed"))
cs.style_controls(fig)
cs.show(fig)
```

## Yearly generation mix

```{python}
#| label: yearly-mix
gy = grouped(m).groupby(m.index.year).sum(min_count=1).loc[2014:] / 1e6
gy["metered total"] = gy[list(GROUPS)].sum(axis=1)
gy["renewable share"] = gy[RENEWABLE].sum(axis=1) / gy["metered total"]
months = m.groupby(m.index.year)["total_mwh"].count().loc[2014:]
gy = gy.sort_index(ascending=False)
labels = {y: (f"{y} (to {last:%d %b})" if months[y] < 12 else str(y)) for y in gy.index}
show = pd.DataFrame({cs.label("generation", k): gy[k].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1)) for k in GROUPS})
show["Total (TWh)"] = gy["metered total"].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1))
show["Renewable share"] = gy["renewable share"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0%}")
show["Unmetered solar (est.)"] = gy["solar_unmetered"].map(lambda v: "–" if pd.isna(v) or v == 0 else fmt(v, 1))
show.index = [labels[y] for y in gy.index]
Markdown(show.to_markdown(disable_numparse=True, colalign=["left"] + ["right"] * len(show.columns)))
```

TWh of metered generation by source. Coal combines lignite, imported coal and hard coal; hydro combines dam and run-of-river plants. The renewable share counts hydro, wind, solar, geothermal and biomass, over metered generation only.

## Demand

Consumption here is the real-time series published by EPİAŞ. From 30 December 2020 it also counts demand met by unmetered generation (the next section explains what that is), which made reported consumption jump by about 3% overnight. To compare years before and after that date, the table shows consumption **as reported** and **net of unmetered generation**: reported consumption minus our estimate of unmetered generation.

```{python}
#| label: yearly-demand
cy = m[["consumption_mwh", "embedded_gen_est_mwh"]].groupby(m.index.year).sum(min_count=1).loc[2017:] / 1e6
cy["net"] = cy["consumption_mwh"] - cy["embedded_gen_est_mwh"].fillna(0)
peak = m["peak_consumption_mw"].groupby(m.index.year).max().loc[2017:]
cy = cy[cy.index < last.year]
growth = lambda s: s.pct_change().map(lambda v: "–" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:+.1%}".replace("-", "−"))
tab = pd.DataFrame({
    "Reported (TWh)": cy["consumption_mwh"].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1)),
    "Growth, reported": growth(cy["consumption_mwh"]),
    "Net of unmetered (TWh)": cy["net"].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1)),
    "Growth, net of unmetered": growth(cy["net"]),
    "Peak demand (MW)": peak.loc[cy.index].map(lambda v: fmt(v)),
}).sort_index(ascending=False)
tab.index = tab.index.astype(str)
tab.index.name = None
g21r, g21n = cy["consumption_mwh"].pct_change().get(2021), cy["net"].pct_change().get(2021)
Markdown(tab.to_markdown(disable_numparse=True, colalign=["left"] + ["right"] * len(tab.columns)))
```

Full years only. Reported consumption grew by `{python} f"{g21r:.1%}"` in 2021, but only by `{python} f"{g21n:.1%}"` net of unmetered generation: the difference is the change in how the series is counted, not extra demand. In later years, a gap between the two growth rates mostly reflects the growth of unmetered generation, largely rooftop and other small solar plants.

## Generation the real-time data does not see

Many small plants, mostly rooftop and other unlicensed solar, are not metered by the system operator in real time. Part of what they produce is used on the spot by the building or factory that owns them, so it never travels through the grid; the rest goes into the local distribution network. Either way it is missing from the generation data above, yet it lowers the demand that the rest of the power system has to serve.

Since 30 December 2020 real-time consumption includes the demand these plants meet. That gives a way to estimate them: **consumption minus metered generation minus net imports**. In the data this estimate is close to zero at night and follows the sun by day, which is what unmetered solar would do. It also picks up any other unmetered generation and metering differences, so it is an estimate, not a measurement. It cannot be built for earlier years, because consumption did not include these plants then.

```{python}
#| label: unmetered-chart
um = m.loc["2021-01-01":, ["embedded_gen_est_mwh", "consumption_mwh"]].copy()
um = um[complete.loc[um.index]]
um["gen_twh"] = um["embedded_gen_est_mwh"].clip(lower=0) / 1e6
um["share"] = um["embedded_gen_est_mwh"].clip(lower=0) / um["consumption_mwh"] * 100

figu = cs.figure(None, "TWh per month", height=400)
cs.add_bar(figu, um.index, um["gen_twh"], "generation", "solar_unmetered", name="Unmetered generation (estimate)",
           hover_fmt=",.2f", unit=" TWh")
cs.add_bar(figu, um.index, um["share"], "generation", "solar_unmetered", name="Share of reported consumption (estimate)",
           hover_fmt=",.1f", unit="%")
figu.data[1].update(visible=False)
figu.update_layout(
    showlegend=False, bargap=0.2, margin=dict(t=48),
    updatemenus=[dict(type="buttons", direction="right", active=0, x=0, y=1.03, xanchor="left", yanchor="bottom",
                      buttons=[dict(label="TWh", method="update",
                                    args=[{"visible": [True, False]},
                                          {"yaxis.title.text": "TWh per month", "yaxis.ticksuffix": "", "yaxis.autorange": True}]),
                               dict(label="% of consumption", method="update",
                                    args=[{"visible": [False, True]},
                                          {"yaxis.title.text": "Share of reported consumption", "yaxis.ticksuffix": "%",
                                           "yaxis.autorange": True}])])],
)
cs.style_controls(figu)
cs.show(figu)
```

```{python}
#| label: unmetered-text
ucur = um.index.max()
uly = ucur - pd.DateOffset(years=1)
u12 = um.iloc[-12:]
txt = (f"In {ucur:%B %Y} the estimate was **{um.loc[ucur, 'gen_twh']:.1f} TWh**, or **{um.loc[ucur, 'share']:.0f}%** of reported consumption"
       + (f", against {um.loc[uly, 'share']:.0f}% in {uly:%B %Y}" if uly in um.index else "") + ". "
       f"Over the last 12 complete months it ranged from {u12['share'].min():.0f}% ({u12['share'].idxmin():%B}) "
       f"to {u12['share'].max():.0f}% ({u12['share'].idxmax():%B}): it follows the sun, not demand. ")
try:
    cap = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data/processed/ren_capacity_monthly.csv", parse_dates=["month"]).set_index("month")["solar_unlicensed_mw"].dropna()
    cm_ = cap.index[cap.index <= ucur].max()
    cf = um.loc[cm_, "embedded_gen_est_mwh"] / (cap.loc[cm_] * cm_.days_in_month * 24) * 100
    txt += (f"As a rough check, EPİAŞ's capacity series lists {cap.loc[cm_] / 1000:.1f} GW of unlicensed solar in {cm_:%B %Y} "
            f"(unit assumed to be MW); the estimate for that month equals {cf:.0f}% of that capacity running all month, "
            f"which is a plausible figure for solar.")
except Exception:
    pass
Markdown(txt)
```

## Notes {#notes}

- **Source:** EPİAŞ Şeffaflık Platformu real-time generation and real-time consumption, through [eptr2](https://github.com/Tideseed/eptr2). Data to `{python} f"{last:%d %B %Y}"`.
- **Coverage:** generation from January 2014 (EPİAŞ added plants to the series during 2013), consumption from March 2016, cross-border flows from 2018.
- **Unmetered solar:** real-time generation misses most small, unlicensed plants connected to distribution grids. We estimate their output as consumption minus metered generation minus net imports, from 30 December 2020, when consumption starts to include it. The estimate also picks up any other unmetered generation and measurement differences, so treat it as approximate.
- **Revisions:** real-time figures are operational data and are revised; final settlement data arrive weeks later.
- See the [methodology](../../methodology.qmd) for definitions and data quality notes.
